**Read this out loud to everyone before you take the photograph.**
I am going to take one photograph of this meeting. It shows Spark that this meeting really happened, and what we did here today.
Being in the photograph is your choice. Nobody has to be in it. If you do not want to be in it, please step to the side now and stand out of the picture. You can also tell me after I take it, and I will delete it and take another one without you.
What you say here stays private. Your name is not written on the photograph, and no name is put next to any answer I write down. What I record is counts: how many people came, and how many people spoke.
The photograph and my notes go to Spark MicroGrants, and to the people who check that this meeting really happened before I am paid. Some meetings are checked by a person, so a real person may look at this photograph.
Being in the photograph does not give you money, a grant, or any other benefit. Stepping out of it costs you nothing and changes nothing for you or your household.

**Werengani mawuwa mokweza kwa aliyense musanajambule chithunzi.**
Ndikufuna ndijambule chithunzi chimodzi cha msonkhano uwu. Chithunzichi chikuonetsa Spark kuti msonkhano uwu unachitikadi, komanso zimene tachita pano lero.
Kukhala mu chithunzichi ndi kusankha kwanu. Palibe amene akukakamizidwa. Ngati simukufuna kukhala mu chithunzichi, chonde sunthani tsopano ndipo imani kunja kwa chithunzi. Mutha kundiuzanso nditajambula, ndipo ndichifafanize n'kujambula china popanda inu.
Zimene mukunena pano ndi zachinsinsi. Dzina lanu silikulembedwa pa chithunzichi, ndipo palibe dzina limene limalembedwa pafupi ndi yankho lililonse limene ndikulemba. Zimene ndikulemba ndi ziwerengero zokha: anthu angati anabwera, ndi anthu angati anayankhula.
Chithunzichi ndi zolemba zanga zimapita ku Spark MicroGrants, komanso kwa anthu amene amaonetsetsa kuti msonkhano uwu unachitikadi ndisanalipidwe. Misonkhano ina imayang'aniridwa ndi munthu weniweni, choncho munthu weniweni angaone chithunzichi.
Kukhala mu chithunzichi sikukupatsani ndalama, thandizo la ndalama, kapena phindu lina lililonse. Kutuluka mu chithunzichi sikukuwonongerani kanthu ndipo sikusintha kalikonse kwa inu kapena banja lanu.

**Ŵerengani ivi mwakukwezga ku ŵanthu wose pambere mundatore chithuzi.**
Nkhukhumba kutora chithuzi chimoza cha ungano uwu. Chithuzi ichi chikulongora ku Spark kuti ungano uwu ukachitika nadi, ndiposo ivyo tachita muhanya uno.
Kuŵa mu chithuzi ntchakusankha kwinu. Palije uyo wakuchichizgika kuŵamo. Usange mukukhumba yayi kuŵamo, sezgerani ku mphepete sono, mwime kuwaro kwa chithuzi. Munganiphaliraso para nate ntachitora, ndipo nizamuchifufuta na kutoraso chinyake mwambura imwe.
Ivyo mukuyowoya pano vikukhala vyachisisi. Zina linu likulembeka pa chithuzi yayi, ndipo palije zina ilo likulembeka pafupi na chizgoro chilichose icho nkhulemba. Ivyo nkhulemba ni maunandi pera: ŵanthu ŵalinga ŵakiza, na ŵanthu ŵalinga ŵakayowoya.
Chithuzi na malemba ghane vikuluta ku Spark MicroGrants, ndiposo ku ŵanthu awo ŵakuwona usange ungano uwu ukachitika nadi pambere nindalipike. Maungano ghanyake ghakuwoneka na munthu, ntheura munthu weneko wangawona chithuzi ichi.
Kuŵa mu chithuzi kukumupani ndalama yayi, nesi thandizo la ndalama, nesi chandulo chilichose. Kufumamo mu chithuzi kukumulipiskani kanthu yayi, ndipo kukusintha kanthu yayi kwa imwe panji nyumba yinu.
